The headliners for the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival are Sabrina Carpenter (Friday), Justin Bieber (Saturday), and Karol G (Sunday), with Anyma presenting ÆDEN in a special midnight slot. The festival takes place over two weekends: April 10–12 and April 17–19, 2026, at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California. Headliners Friday, April 10 & 17: Sabrina Carpenter Saturday, April 11 & 18: Justin Bieber (His first-ever billed Coachella set, performing tracks from Swag and Swag II) Sunday, April 12 & 19: Karol G (The first Latina artist to headline the festival) Notable 2026 Lineup Additions Special Performers: Anyma (presenting ÆDEN), Jack White (added last minute) Returning/Major Acts: The Strokes, The xx, Interpol, David Byrne, Devo, Moby, FKA Twigs, Iggy Pop, Young Thug Pop/Electronic: PinkPantheress, Addison Rae, Teddy Swims, Blood Orange, Central Cee, Katseye, BINI, Major Lazer, Kaskade Key Details Lineup Reveal: The official lineup was unveiled on September 15, 2025. Ticket Status: Tickets went on sale September 19, 2025, and sold out quickly. 25th Edition: 2026 marks the 25th edition of the festival. Surprise Guests (Weekend 1): Performers included Will Ferrell, Susan Sarandon, Lizzo, Joe Jonas, Snoop Dogg, Jennifer Lopez, Travis Barker, Becky G, and Camila Cabello.
